author: Virtual Lab project
license: Project-authored geometry; manufacturer and facility reference material retain original copyright.
notes: Blue perimeter with removable white service cover; exposed circular side RMS valve manifold, 16 sample ports and six calibration inlets, matching facility specification.
Floor-standing external rotary vacuum pump is excluded from the main-unit footprint. RMS rotation is a digital flow-selection demonstration, not a calibrated valve command.
geometry_scope: Source-grounded visual reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD. All joint travel is numeric digital articulation, not measured hardware limits.

community_search.result: No verified licensed downloadable exact-model mesh found. A negative search is not proof that none exists.

protocol_validation_scope: Digital hierarchy, bounded joint movement, reset and ordered access workflow only; no vendor API, real sample handling, vacuum, pressure, laser, thermal or magnetic behavior validated.
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.reviewer: Primary agent visual QA, actual final pipeline renders
review.scope: Photo-grounded digital exterior only; dimension/configuration blockers remain enforced independently.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked
